description: Starling provides an agent-based framework with generic classes for urban public transport, station-based sharing and shared taxis. The provider is Tellae. Geographical and temporal coverage: The repository includes example scenarios and cites a Rennes application from 2020. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is CeCILL-B. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The README states CeCILL-B and warns that documentation is incomplete. The package and example scenarios were not executed. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
